name: fountain
description: Parametric fountain (喷泉): circle or square ground basin (floor disc at y, 1-deep water, full rim ring, lip of upside-down stairs facing outward = flat walkable edge, or a slab cap) + center pillar (wall column is the classic) + 1-3 shrinking upper tiers stacked on the pillar, each a floor disc with stair lip and water, one source on top cascading down. All stair states derived by the script; corners auto-resolved.
when_to_use: Plaza/courtyard/garden centerpiece, park node, estate forecourt. origin = CENTER cell of the basin, y = basin floor layer (one below surrounding pavement if the basin is sunken, or same level for a raised-rim fountain). Pair with plaza (its centerpiece='fountain' reserves the accent disc at exactly this center). DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED — never hand-edit (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 广场/庭院/花园中心水景;圆池(circle)或方池(square);单层(1)庭院小泉,多层(2-3)纪念性喷泉

origin.notes: 水池中心格;y = 池底层(水面在 y+1,池沿在 y+1,压边在 y+2)

radius.notes: 外沿半径(圆)/半边长(方);5 是社区最经典尺寸

tiers.notes: 水层级数;1=单池,2-3=中心柱上叠小池

tier_height.notes: 每层水面上方露出的柱高;也是 tiers=1 时的柱高

shrink.notes: 每上一层半径倍率( radius*shrink^i,最小 1 )

rim_material.notes: 池沿整砖;白/浅风用 quartz_block,沙漠风用 sandstone,海洋风用 prismarine

trim.notes: 压边:stairs=倒放楼梯外张沿(可坐,经典);slab=平半砖盖顶;none=素沿

trim_material.notes: 压边楼梯;trim=slab 时自动换成同名 _slab

pillar_material.notes: 中心柱;墙/栅栏柱是社区经典(GrabCraft 多层喷泉实测),也可用整砖/铁栏杆 iron_bars

water.notes: false=干池(改花坛/雕像基座时关)

pitfalls: origin 是池子中心不是角落;radius 含池沿,水池内壁比 radius 小一圈,别把中心柱位置让给水
中心柱从池底(y)连续堆到顶,中间被各层水盘穿过是设计如此——柱子替换该格的水,不许留空
压边楼梯是'倒放(half=top)背朝外',脚本已按离心力向推导每格 facing,围合转角 shape 自动解析;手改必缺角
水只放源头格:池内每格一个源 + 柱顶一个源;不要在半空画'水帘'列,游戏内会自己流;流水不是静态方块能表达的
上层小池地板悬在柱周:靠柱心水平咬合支撑(验收器认可),但视觉上 tier_height 别超过 5,否则像电线杆挑盘子
radius<=3 时 tiers 最多 2——第三层半径缩到 1 只剩柱顶一碗水,不如不加
example: python patterns/fountain.py --params '{"origin":[100,64,100],"radius":5,"tiers":2}' --out fountain.json && python patterns/fountain.py --params '{"origin":[120,64,100],"shape":"square","radius":4,"trim":"slab","rim_material":"minecraft:quartz_block","floor_material":"minecraft:prismarine"}' --out fountain2.json
